name: Okado Taku
source:
22 year old getting by on part-time employment.

Recently, after a number of employees quit in rapid succession, the owner took on several new hires; but for some reason, instead of everyone chipping in on the cleaning, Okado always winds up stuck doing it.

[Edited from in-game TIPS]
